subject: [PATCH v2 03/11] nfsd: count a delegation in cl_delegs_in_recall only once

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFS server where a delegation is counted multiple times when a client recalls it, leading to incorrect behavior and preventing the client from becoming a courtesy client again. The fix involves checking if the delegation has already been recalled before incrementing the count, and skipping unnecessary increments and decrements under the flc_lock. This patch addresses issues introduced by two previous patches that added courteous server support for threads with only delegations and notification handlers for dir events.
